title: arenaria peploides subsp. major
intro: Arenaria peploides subsp. major, commonly known as Sea Sandwort, is a subspecies of flowering plant that belongs to the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Arenaria peploides subsp. major include wound healing, anti-aging, and protection against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects.
